line: Crowley’s Two of Disks: Chokmah in the suit of Earth (pdf p227); Jupiter and Capricornus (pdf p227); formerly the Lord of Harmonious Change (pdf p176).

sections.title: Title and suit
sections.line: Crowley on the card’s title (pdf p176); on the suit and its element (pdf p24).

quotes.quote: The Two of Pentacles was of old time called the Lord of Harmonious Change.

sections.title: Its place on the Tree
sections.line: Crowley on the Two and Chokmah in the suit of Earth (pdf p227); on the Twos and Chokmah (pdf p35).

quotes.quote: The number Two, Chokmah, here rules in the suit pertaining to Earth.

sections.title: What it figures
sections.line: Crowley on the card as the picture of the manifested Universe and on the interplay of the Four Elements (pdf p227).

quotes.quote: One may in fact consider the card as the picture of the complete manifested Universe
They thus represent the harmonious interplay of the Four Elements in constant movement.

sections.title: Jupiter and Capricornus
sections.line: Crowley on the card’s celestial rulers (pdf p227).

quotes.quote: Its celestial rulers are Jupiter and Capricornus
these symbols are most inharmonious, so that in practical matters the good fortune of Jupiter is very limited.
